output.draft:
## Overview
Tabletop Paper Bridge Kit offers families at a fictional weekend making club a hands-on bridge activity.

## Background
The kit introduces simple bridge construction through paper parts.

## Use
Follow the illustrated assembly cards, connect foldable paper beams with reusable clips, and test the finished bridge with small wooden tokens.
